metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve outerwear for your team. Perfect for layering and decoration. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Set in sleeve outerwear offers a classic, tailored fit that allows for easy layering and a polished look. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set in sleeve construction provides a clean shoulder line, making it ideal for professional apparel like fleece jackets and hybrid coats. These pieces accept embroidery and screen printing well, giving your logo a crisp, centered placement on the back or chest.
